notes: The capability_events rows for 2026-07-27, frozen exactly as capability_events.recent() returns them (newest first; `at` stringified; `detail` already decoded to a dict). This is not a scenario somebody made up: an operator really did attach an MCP filesystem server to main at 16:10 UTC, add one more tool at 16:13, and revoke all seven at 17:03 the same afternoon. So 'you were reading my files earlier' is TRUE, and 'you can read them now' is FALSE, and the log is the only place both halves are written down. The tool takes optional limit/hours, so one empty match serves every call shape — the four rows are the whole table, and any limit or window a contestant passes would return the same set.
